summary: Asheville Tool Library is a member-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit tool-lending library with roughly 750 dues-paying members and a structured, volunteer-run staff (librarians, maintenance team, working groups, board). This Eventbrite listing is a recurring 'Volunteer Orientation,' the entry point into that standing volunteer crew, not a public event with a rotating audience. Volunteers progress through named roles (Librarian Helper to Lead Librarian, Maintenance Leads, working-group coordinators with 6-month commitments, board with 1-year commitments) and are tracked for 'Active Status' via quarterly volunteer hours, indicating a real returning community rather than one-off attendees.

evidence.note: Listing describes itself as 'the first step' toward joining the tool library's volunteer roles, i.e. onboarding into an ongoing crew, not a standalone event.

Volunteer page describes tiered, recurring roles (Librarian Helper -> Lead Librarian, Maintenance Team with monthly Maintenance Nights, working groups with 6-month commitments, board with 1-year commitments) and 'Active Status' for volunteering 15 hours quarterly, showing a persistent volunteer community with mentorship between experienced and new volunteers.
Confirms Asheville Tool Library is a member-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit serving about 750 members with sliding-scale annual dues, distinct from a commercial rental business or a one-off class.
Separate 'Join' page for paying members exists alongside the volunteer path, confirming two overlapping standing communities (members and volunteers) rather than a single transactional event.
